description: On the 141-to-155-second return, KEEPSAKE more closely preserves the right-hand multi-storey building and courtyard arrangement. Unbounded returns with the building shifted toward the right edge and a changed courtyard composition. Neither output is pixel-identical on return.

GT returns to the stone-wall and fluted-column view. KEEPSAKE retains more of that arrangement; Unbounded introduces a large ornamental band into the left wall. Both generated intervening views differ from GT, and the returned views are not exact reconstructions.
